title: MC Musics
description: A mod that lets you play Minecraft music manually.
body:
## MC Musics – Play Any Minecraft Music Anytime!

Minecraft has one of the most iconic soundtracks in gaming. The peaceful background music makes exploring, building, and surviving even more enjoyable. But normally, you have to wait for the game to randomly play a song.

That's where **MC Musics** comes in!

**MC Music** is a simple Fabric mod that lets you play any official Minecraft music whenever you want with just a single key press.

---

# Features

## 🎵 Play Any Minecraft Music Instantly

Press the **U** key (default keybind) to open the Music Menu.

> **Default Key:** `U` *(Fully customizable in Minecraft Controls settings.)*

Inside the GUI, you'll find a collection of Minecraft's official music tracks. Simply click on any song to start playing it instantly.

---

## 📚 Beautiful Music Library

The music selection screen displays useful information for every track, including:

* 🎼 Music Name
* 👤 Official Composer/Author
* ⏱ Music Duration
* ▶ One-click Play

Everything is organized in a clean and easy-to-use interface.

---

## 🏆 "Now Playing" Toast Notification

Whenever a music track starts playing, **either automatically by Minecraft or manually through the mod**, you'll see a beautiful advancement-style toast notification in the corner of your screen.

It displays:

* 🎵 **Now Playing**
* 📀 Music Name

This makes the experience feel just like Minecraft's built-in notifications while letting you know exactly which soundtrack is currently playing.

## 🔍 Search Your Favourite Music Instantly

Looking for a specific Minecraft soundtrack? MC Musics includes a built-in **Search** feature that helps you quickly find any available music track.

Simply type the song's name, and the list updates instantly, making it easy to play your favourite music without scrolling through the entire library.

---

## 🕒 Recently Played History

MC Musics also keeps track of your **recently played songs**.

The **History** section lets you quickly access tracks you've listened to before, so you can replay your favourite Minecraft music with just a single click instead of searching for it again.


---

## ⚙ Fully Customizable Keybind

Don't like using the **U** key?

No problem!

You can change the keybind anytime from:

`Options → Controls → Key Binds`

Choose any key you prefer.

---

# Why Use MC Musics?

Minecraft has dozens of amazing music tracks, but many players never hear their favorites because the game plays them randomly.

MC Music gives you complete control over the soundtrack, allowing you to:

* Listen to your favourite Minecraft songs anytime
* Create the perfect atmosphere while building
* Relax with peaceful music during exploration
* Enjoy the official soundtrack without waiting for random playback

---

# Perfect For

* Builders
* Survival Players
* Creative Mode
* Roleplay Worlds
* Content Creators
* Streamers
* Minecraft Music Lovers

---

# Compatibility

* ✅ Fabric Loader
* ✅ Client-side Mod
* ✅ Multiplayer Compatible
* ✅ Lightweight & Performance Friendly

---

# How to Use

1. Install **MC Music** with Fabric.
2. Launch Minecraft.
3. Press **U** *(or your custom keybind)*.
4. Browse the music library.
5. Click any song to play it instantly.
6. Enjoy the official Minecraft soundtrack whenever you want!

---
